# ebitengine-message-frame

[ebitengine](https://ebitengine.org)'s message frame library like Dragon Quest.

![example](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/237271/418836461-f94bbe46-edaa-4628-ae62-171a64018dcd.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJnaXRodWIuY29tIiwiYXVkIjoicmF3LmdpdGh1YnVzZXJjb250ZW50LmNvbSIsImtleSI6ImtleTUiLCJleHAiOjE3NDEwNjMzOTEsIm5iZiI6MTc0MTA2MzA5MSwicGF0aCI6Ii8yMzcyNzEvNDE4ODM2NDYxLWY5NGJiZTQ2LWVkYWEtNDYyOC1hZTYyLTE3MWE2NDAxOGRjZC5wbmc_.h9VJV5ZLBwdpllzHDIGQY5OSCD3rZmEvL4rFZ2iDUpg)

## Usage

```go
import "github.com/raa0121/ebitengine-message-frame"

frame.DrawFrame(screen, frameImage, []string{"aaaaaa", "bbbbbbbbbbb", "cccccccccc"}, fontFace, 0, 0)
```

## Requirements

go 1.23.2

## Installation

go get github.com/raa0121/ebitengine-message-frame@latest
